answers.question: What is the current status of his boiler job and what does it mean for him?
answers.answer: The job is at double_quotation. The £780 expansion vessel quote is with the landlord, who asked for a second quote. Swift P&H are due 14 Oct. The repair is not yet approved, so he keeps repressurising the boiler meanwhile and should report any loss of heating or hot water. He is vulnerable, so I asked whether heating and hot water are working.

answers.question: How do you handle the bin question?
answers.answer: It is not a maintenance matter. Collections are run by Tower Hamlets Council, so I gave no date and pointed him to the council's missed-collection report.

answers.question: Do you create any new tickets?
answers.answer: No. The boiler job already exists and the bin issue is not a repair.

assumptions: Replied by email, as the tenant prefers it and the send tool has no portal channel
Swift visit date is from the system note and is treated as unconfirmed by the provider in my message

args.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your messages on the portal, and sorry it has felt slow. Boiler (R-4799): the engineer visited and found the part that is probably causing the pressure drop (the expansion vessel). The repair quote has gone to your landlord, who has asked for a second quote before deciding. Swift P&H are down to visit on 14 October to give it; we are confirming that date with them and will tell you if it changes. Until the repair is approved, please keep topping up the pressure as you have been doing. If you lose heating or hot water, or see leaking or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas smell: leave the property and call 0800 111 999). We will update you again by Wednesday 14 October. Bins: we don't manage collections, so I can't give you a date. Tower Hamlets Council runs them, and you can report a missed collection on their website. If it is a shared bin store problem, tell us and we will look into it. Is your heating and hot water working at the moment?
